stories.headline: 17th place Bideford held league leaders Weymouth to a 1-1 draw at The Sports Ground…
stories.body: 17th place Bideford held league leaders Weymouth to a 1-1 draw at The Sports Ground, and Bideford were leading through Ryan Downing’s 46th minute strike until 96th minute heartbreak, with Kieran Douglas snatching a point for the Terras.

stories.headline: They did just that, with a seventh win in a row, beating Slimbridge 4-2 thanks…
stories.body: They did just that, with a seventh win in a row, beating Slimbridge 4-2 thanks to Leighton Thomas, Joshua Jenkins and Bevan Cross putting them 3-0 up, before Theo Browne got one back for Slimbridge.

stories.headline: A second hat-trick in two games from Olaf Koszela helped Dorchester Town to back-to-back wins…
stories.body: A second hat-trick in two games from Olaf Koszela helped Dorchester Town to back-to-back wins, beating Falmouth Town 1-4 in Cornwall. Harrison Jewell got the goal for Falmouth who made it 1-1, which is how they went in at the break, with Ethan Taylor getting the other goal for Dorchester to make it 1-3 at the time.

stories.body: Swindon Supermarine are three without a win, now including two defeats, after falling to a 3-1 defeat at Sporting Club Inkberrow , and will be without Jacob Bancroft in a weeks time following a seance yellow card.

stories.headline: Two first-half goals were enough to see Hungerford Town pick up three points at bottom…
stories.body: Two first-half goals were enough to see Hungerford Town pick up three points at bottom of the table Bristol Manor Farm with a 0-2 win. Hartpury ’s charge continues after a sixth win in seven, following a 0-3 win at Larkhall Athletic , and like Hungerford all goals came in the first half, a brace from Louis Manning either side of a Cam Walters 20th minute strike.
